title: Malhotra ne meri poori presentation apne naam kar li... phir slide 7 aayi | Anhoni #shorts

characters.simran: Simran, an attractive stylish confident curvy young Indian woman in her mid-20s, natural hourglass figure, warm medium-brown skin, glossy voluminous wavy jet-black hair, tasteful glam makeup with defined eyes and soft lip, gold jhumka earrings; wears a stylish tan-brown formal blazer suit over a crisp white collared shirt buttoned up (modest neckline, no cleavage), a slim belt, company ID on a maroon lanyard; confident poised expression. Distinctive: tan-brown suit + maroon lanyard always visible.
characters.malhotra: Grumpy manager, late-40s, round face, medium-brown skin, thick black moustache, balding with combed-back side hair, reading glasses on nose-tip, light-grey formal shirt with tight maroon tie, visible paunch, permanent frown

intro: POV: 2 hafte tumne PPT banaya, aur present manager karega.
music_prompt: light quirky corporate background music, deadpan playful-tense, minimal, no vocals

panels.text: POV: kaam mera, presentation Malhotra sir ki.
panels.prompt: Wide shot of a premium glass-walled office corridor, Simran walking with a laptop deadpan, Malhotra ahead adjusting his maroon tie proudly, morning light, sleek interiors; premium comic style

panels.text: PPT mujhe bhej de. Client ke saamne main bolunga.
panels.prompt: Over-shoulder shot, Malhotra leaning at Simran's cubicle, hand outstretched, frowning, glasses on nose-tip, Simran seated looking up deadpan, dual monitors glowing; premium comic style

panels.text: Teesri baar. Iss baar footer set kar diya.
panels.prompt: Tight close-up on Simran's laptop, cursor on slide 7 footer text, her faint knowing smile reflected in the screen; premium comic style

panels.text: Tum bas notes lena. Lead main karunga.
panels.prompt: Glass meeting room, Malhotra straightening tie at the head of the table, Simran quietly opening the deck on the big screen, deadpan; premium corporate comic style

panels.text: Sir, yeh poori strategy maine design ki hai.
panels.prompt: Wide meeting-room shot, Malhotra presenting to CEO and 2 clients, chest puffed, pointing proudly at the big screen, Simran seated at side quietly; premium comic style

panels.text: Slide 7 tak ruk jao, Malhotra sir.
panels.prompt: Close-up of Simran, faint amused smile, eyes fixed on the big screen, hands folded calmly; blurred meeting room behind; premium comic style

panels.text: Next slide pe hum ROI dikhate hain—
panels.prompt: Malhotra mid-sentence gesturing at big screen confidently, sweat not yet started, CEO watching; premium comic style

panels.text: Ek second — footer me 'Prepared by: Simran' kyun hai?
panels.prompt: Screen close-up: slide 7 footer clearly reads 'Prepared by: Simran'. CEO leaning forward pointing, Malhotra frozen mid-gesture, sweating, glasses slipping; premium comic style

panels.text: Simran, baaki slides aap hi samjha dijiye.
panels.prompt: Meeting room, CEO turning warmly toward Simran who stands up poised, Malhotra slumped and frowning, glasses slipping, clients nodding; premium comic style

panels.text: Credit chori karne walo... footer bhi padh liya karo.
panels.prompt: Final hero shot: Simran standing tall at the screen, gold jhumkas catching light, subtle victorious smile, blurred deflated Malhotra behind; caption bar across bottom; premium comic style

caption:
Har office me ek Malhotra hota hai jo aapka kaam apne naam kar leta hai. Par is baar slide 7 ne sab bol diya. 😏
Simran ka next move? Part 2 ke liye Follow karo!
